banner: VQ2-A2-R2 BUILT — FLAT ARTWORK PRESENTATION. AWAITING OWNER REVIEW. NOT ACCEPTANCE, NOT PRODUCTION ARTWORK.

before_r2.method: per-component Bezier geometry measured against the CANONICAL centerline OX=36.541193mm, not a self-derived bbox midpoint (a self-derived centre cannot detect centreline deviation and would have reported a false pass)
before_r2.note: A composite silhouette check on the PNG reported 145/148 rows within 1px and would have wrongly cleared this. The raster is ~0.09mm per pixel against a 0.01mm tolerance, and merging the three components hides an off-centre closure inside the outer silhouette.

symmetry.method_note: measured against the CANONICAL centerline. A self-derived bbox midpoint reported 145/148 rows clean and would have wrongly passed the off-centre closure.

logo_validation.segment_count_reconciliation: The canonical record reports 341 emitted segments; R2 emits 350. The difference is bookkeeping, not content. Both carry the SAME 314 source path items. The canonical figure counts one MoveTo per component (9) + 314 items + 18 ClosePath = 341. R2 counts one MoveTo per SUBPATH (18) + 314 items + 18 ClosePath = 350. R2 has nine more MoveTos precisely BECAUSE the R1 defect is fixed — every subpath now starts its own contour instead of continuing from the previous one. A count of 341 here would mean the defect was still present.

flat_artwork.derivation: one median colour sampled per component from concept #97 — a single flat tone each, so no gradient exists

lettering.derivation: convert_glyph on the same instance with the same max_err_units — the emitted outlines are LF1-R1s own geometry, uniformly scaled to working size only

r2.typography_freeze_method: the R1 point-set comparison is NOT reusable — R2 emits the structure as dense polylines whose points fall inside the product-name band and swamp it. The guarantee is the font-unit contour hash plus the LF1-R1 file hash, both unchanged.
r2.m3_divergence_note: M3's own DARK_CLOSURE data is what was asymmetric (8.531533 mm out, 1.198714 mm off centre). R2 renders a symmetrised closure derived from M3's canonical left half. The M3 record on disk is untouched; this is a derived correction, not an edit to M3, and it is the correction the owner asked for.

defect_2_logo_fidelity.symptom: counters of B, B, R, O, S, E are filled solid; the medallion rose silhouette is destroyed; the registered symbol is a blob
defect_2_logo_fidelity.root_cause: the extraction loop inserted a MoveTo only for the FIRST item of each drawing, so every subsequent subpath continued from the previous point instead of starting its own contour, and all subpaths were merged into a single filled Path with no fill rule. Counters could not knock out.
defect_2_logo_fidelity.same_class_as: the Qu2CuPen defect — a converter silently dropping what its handler does not cover
